hero.title: Talk to Your Business
hero.description: Ask a question, give an instruction, or just think out loud — the assistant handles the rest in under 300ms.

differentiator.title: AI that never writes without a click.
differentiator.subline: It navigates the app, fills forms, and drafts anything — but every database change waits for your confirmation.

intro: When you talk to the HABOS assistant, it already knows your projects, your calendar, your team, and your recent conversations. It doesn't need you to explain context — it has it. Ask 'how are receivables looking?' and it queries your finance data. Say 'draft a follow-up to Sarah' and it pulls the last email thread, your CRM notes, and her sentiment trend. Then it writes the draft and waits for you to approve before sending. One conversation replaces five apps and ten clicks.

mockConversation.userMessage: What's on my calendar tomorrow and draft a follow-up email to Sarah about the renovation quote
mockConversation.assistantMessage: You have 3 meetings tomorrow. The first is at 9 am with the Henderson team. I've drafted a follow-up to Sarah — here's a preview:
mockConversation.emailBody: Hi Sarah, just circling back on the quote we discussed...
mockConversation.footer: One sentence. Two systems updated. Zero app switching.

items.text: Average time saved by replacing app-switching with voice commands. Ask instead of click.
Calendar, email, tasks, CRM, and search — all accessible in a single conversation.
Say 'log 3 hours on the Henderson job' and the timesheet, project, and billing update themselves.

context.title: Always knows your context
context.description: The assistant rebuilds its context every session — your profile, active projects, upcoming events, team structure, and available data. You never need to explain who you are or what you're working on.

closing.tagline: Other apps give you a chatbot. VOIS gives you a business partner.
